policy._doc: What a release must have verified (docs/plan-release-validation.md; scripts/release-changes.ts). Each cause of change is drawn on its own, big changes likelier, until its guarantee holds: the error rate's upper bound below `tolerance` at `confidence`, with at most `allowed` errors found. Visible changes (names, addresses, places new or gone) allow none; the sun and footprints one. Tolerance 5 % for this first release (production a month behind, no footprints yet), then 2 % for visible changes (the owner's decision, 2026-10-21).
